title: AuthoringOutcomeRequest
description: Body of POST /api/authoring/requests/:id/outcome (HEL-401 design.md D4) — a telemetry-only correlation signal the Proposal Review UI fires from its Accept/Reject actions when the reviewed proposal carries an authoringRequestId. This endpoint never touches POST /api/dashboards/apply-proposal's own persistence path; it only emits a correlated telemetry log line.

outcome.description: accepted (fired after applyDashboardProposal succeeds) or rejected (fired when the reviewer declines the proposal).
